email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with mild nausea

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


This is a resend of my earlier report in case it did not arrive.

A 71-year-old female patient with a history of hypertension received their third dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 500mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-04-27.
Approximately 5 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild nausea.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
K. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
